against.description: the old policy as HuJSON text; leave it out to make the live policy the old side

fromChange.description: continue a listing: the nextChange of the previous result for the same two policies

fromVersion.description: the old side is the policy of this version id from acl_history

ignoreTailscaleWritten.description: leave the constructs Tailscale writes itself out of the list and out of equal; they are still counted

patch.description: RFC 6902 operations, as JSON text, applied to the live policy to make the new side; over MCP a user is named by pseudonym, in a file by login

policy.description: the new policy as HuJSON text, a top-level object; leave it and patch out to make the live policy the new side

section.description: list only the changes in one section: a section name in any case, or unknown for the sections this version does not know

toVersion.description: the new side is the policy of this version id from acl_history

changes.description: one page of the changes, defaults, testsReduced and widening first

class.description: defaults, testsReduced, widening, tailscaleWritten or semantic

entry.description: the entry's key, or a summary of the rule or assertion

fields.description: what a changed entry gained and lost, field by field

new.description: the entry on the new side, in canonical form

newLine.description: in the new side's text, from 1; never for a patch: the caller wrote operations, not that text

newPointer.description: JSON pointer into the new side

note.description: a fixed sentence that qualifies the change; it never quotes the policy: what a note is about is in fields

old.description: the entry on the old side, in canonical form

oldCount.description: how many times a repeated entry (a test) is on the old side

oldLine.description: in the old side's text, from 1

oldPointer.description: JSON pointer into the old side

section.description: acls, grants, acls+grants (a rule in both), another section, or the name of a section this version does not know

truncated.description: old or new was cut at 1 KiB

counts.description: the changes of every page, by class; commentOnly and formatOnly are counts only

externallyManaged.description: true, false or unknown: the live policy is managed outside the admin console; absent when no side is live

matched.description: the changes the section filter and the options select, over every page

findings.description: what was found in this side by itself: a text that is not a policy, a key written twice, a section this version does not know

kind.description: the kind of finding, as the tool's description lists

line.description: from 1, counting line feeds as Tailscale does; absent when unknown

moreCandidates.description: more places match, past the cap

pointer.description: JSON pointer, when the line is not known

source.description: where the position is: from, against, patch (the patch, or the policy it makes: a pointer), invariants, live or version; empty for a message about the text as a whole

omitted.description: findings left out past the cap

policySha256.description: SHA-256 of the policy as acl_get shows it

policyVersion.description: for the live policy: a keyed digest of its ETag, or the ETag with personalData show; absent otherwise

source.description: live, text (the text of an MCP call), file (named on the command line), patch (the live policy with the patch applied) or version (a stored policy)

version.description: the version id, when source is version

normalFormLimits.description: why a changed may be false

notChecked.description: what a comparison does not establish: a small change to an alias or a group can widen access

version.description: the version id, when source is version

section.description: the section filter this result applied, in the engine's spelling; the counts are of every section, matched and changes are of this one

semanticallyEqual.description: the two mean the same: exact when true; false can be a false changed for a rewrite the normal form does not reduce (see normalFormLimits)

status.description: equal, changed or invalid (a side is not a policy, and nothing was compared)

tailscaleWrittenAsOf.description: the date of the list of constructs Tailscale writes itself

tailscaleWrittenIgnored.description: ignoreTailscaleWritten was set: they are counted and not listed, and they do not make the result changed

truncated.description: more changes follow this page: call again with fromChange set to nextChange
